note: Adapted from the alate description of Holmgren and Holmgren (1917) and Ahmad (1955) as reported by Chhotani (1997); the original is in English; only the alate is known, the soldier and worker being unknown; the synonymy list, literature citations, figure numbers, measurement tables and distribution records are omitted; the upper limit of pronotum width and the upper limit of ocellar short diameter are not recorded because of OCR damage.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Alate distinctly smaller than the other known species of the genus; postclypeus shorter than half its width, whereas in the remaining species of the genus the postclypeus is about equal to half its width.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head brown to chestnut brown; antennae and postclypeus yellowish brown; pronotum and abdominal dorsum slightly paler than the head, abdominal sternites paler still. Head with abundant short hairs and long hairs. Head capsule subcircular; head length to tip of labrum 0.91–1.09 mm, head length to mandibular base 0.70–0.77 mm, width 0.90–1.03 mm. Compound eyes moderate in size, prominent, their distance from the lower margin of the head less than half their diameter; maximum diameter of compound eye 0.19–0.21 mm, distance from the lower margin of the head 0.09 mm. Ocelli oval, rather large, long diameter 0.09–0.12 mm, lower limit of short diameter 0.07 mm; distance from the compound eye about half their long diameter. Antennae 15-segmented, segment 2 almost as long as segments 3 and 4 together, segment 3 shorter than or nearly equal to segment 4. Postclypeus shorter than or nearly equal to half its width, hairy. Mandibles each with 2 marginal teeth. Pronotum semicircular, with a paler T-shaped mark and shoulder marks, and another median mark above the median notch of the posterior margin; anterior margin straight, posterior margin deeply concave; length 0.50–0.54 mm.
